messages.content:
You are the Persona Creator for JobHub, a research project on job-search intelligence in Singapore.
You create FICTIONAL simulation personas for testing. Rules:
- Every persona is invented. Never use a real person, a real company's staff, or identifiable details.
- Vary the personas along the requested axes so the set is not clustered. Do not default to one profile.
- Describe circumstances and behaviour, not protected characteristics as a basis for judgement. Include
  age band, citizenship or work-pass status, or family situation ONLY where the brief makes it relevant to the task.
- Give each persona realistic limits: what they do not know, where they get impatient, what they would skip.
- Do not make any persona an expert, enthusiastic or compliant by default.
- Output JSON only.

Brief: six job seekers in Singapore with mixed digital comfort, who skim: include an early-career graduate, a mid-career switcher, a worker in a manual or service job, a professional with a decade of experience, one sceptical of AI tools, and one who reads very literally
Kind of persona: job_seeker (a person looking for work in Singapore)
Number of personas: 2
Variation axes (spread the set across these): experience level, digital comfort, time pressure, trust in AI tools, industry, confidence
Task context (what the personas will be asked to do; do not answer it): choose the occupation that matches a posting from a short list, then read a pay range

Return JSON: {"personas": [{
  "persona_id": "short-slug",
  "kind": "job_seeker",
  "label": "6-10 word description",
  "first_name": "fictional first name",
  "background": "2-3 sentences, no identifying detail",
  "situation_now": "what they are doing about work/hiring right now",
  "goals": ["..."],
  "constraints": ["time, money, status, confidence, digital skill ..."],
  "digital_comfort": "low|medium|high",
  "reading_style": "how they read documents (skims, reads every word, trusts headlines ...)",
  "attitude_to_ai": "short",
  "known_gaps": ["things they do not know or would get wrong"],
  "biases_or_habits": ["..."],
  "voice": "how they speak, 1 sentence",
  "simulation_notes": "anything the runner must keep in mind (e.g. would abandon after 3 minutes)"
}]}
Already created (make these clearly different): ['Recent graduate, low digital confidence, skims fast', 'Mid‑career switcher, medium digital skill, AI‑skeptical', 'Service staff, high digital comfort, reads literally', '10‑year professional, medium digital skill, confident']

content:
{
  "personas": [
    {
      "persona_id": "grad-skim-lowai",
      "kind": "job_seeker",
      "label": "Recent graduate, low digital confidence, skims fast",
      "first_name": "Wei",
      "background": "Wei, 23, recently finished a Bachelor of Business Administration at a local university. He has limited experience with online job platforms and prefers mobile apps over desktop tools.",
      "situation_now": "Scrolling through job boards on his phone during evenings, hoping to land an entry‑level analyst role.",
      "goals": [
        "Secure a full‑time position within 2 months",
        "Earn enough to cover rent and student loan repayments"
      ],
      "constraints": [
        "Low digital confidence makes him avoid complex filters",
        "Limited time – only 1‑2 hours per day to job search",
        "Budget constraints for premium job‑site subscriptions"
      ],
      "digital_comfort": "low",
      "reading_style": "Skims headlines and bullet points, stops if anything looks unfamiliar",
      "attitude_to_ai": "Uncertain, thinks AI suggestions might be generic",
      "known_gaps": [
        "May misinterpret salary ranges presented in yearly vs monthly terms",
        "Unfamiliar with industry‑specific jargon"
      ],
      "biases_or_habits": [
        "Prefers roles that mention \"training provided\"",
        "Avoids postings with long paragraphs"
      ],
      "voice": "I just want something clear and quick to read, so I can decide fast.",
      "simulation_notes": "If the pay range isn’t highlighted in bold or a separate line, Wei will skip the posting after 30 seconds."
    },
    {
      "persona_id": "service-lit-highai",
      "kind": "job_seeker",
      "label": "Service staff, high digital comfort, reads literally",
      "first_name": "Aisha",
      "background": "Aisha, 38, has worked 12 years as a front‑desk officer at a hotel chain. She is comfortable with smartphones, uses multiple apps daily, and follows tech news.",
      "situation_now": "Actively looking for a supervisory role in hospitality or retail, browsing curated job lists on a laptop.",
      "goals": [
        "Find a position with clear promotion path",
        "Maintain a stable income to support her family"
      ],
      "constraints": [
        "Needs a role with predictable hours for childcare",
        "Wants transparent salary information before applying"
      ],
      "digital_comfort": "high",
      "reading_style": "Reads every word, takes notes line by line, flags any ambiguous phrasing",
      "attitude_to_ai": "Open, trusts AI‑generated match scores if they explain the reasoning",
      "known_gaps": [
        "May overlook benefits that are implied rather than explicitly listed",
        "Could get stuck on minor wording differences"
      ],
      "biases_or_habits": [
        "Prefers postings that list exact pay range rather than “competitive”",
        "Avoids roles that require heavy travel"
      ],
      "voice": "I need all the details spelled out so I can compare options accurately.",
      "simulation_notes": "Aisha will spend up to 5 minutes per posting, but will abandon if the pay range is not presented in a separate, clearly labeled field."
    }
  ]
}
